description: This file defines the NotesRepository class, which provides data access methods for managing Note objects, including create, get, list, update, and delete operations, using SQLAlchemy's asynchronous session.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository class for CRUD operations on notes in the database.

methods.name: None __init__(self, session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Initializes NotesRepository with an asynchronous database session.

methods.name: Note create(self, title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new Note with given title and content, saves it to the database, and returns the Note object.

methods.name: Optional[Note] get(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a Note by its ID, returns None if not found.

methods.name: List[Note] list(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes ordered by creation time descending.

methods.name: Note update(self, note: Note, *, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str])
methods.description: Updates the provided Note object with optional new title and content, flushes and refreshes the object, then returns it.

methods.name: None delete(self, note: Note)
methods.description: Deletes the specified Note object from the database.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    async def create(self, title: str, content: str) -> Note:$/

ctags.name: delete
ctags.pattern: /^    async def delete(self, note: Note) -> None:$/

ctags.name: get
ctags.pattern: /^    async def get(self, note_id: int) -> Optional[Note]:$/

ctags.name: update
ctags.pattern: /^    async def update(self, note: Note, *, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str]) -> Note:$/
ctags.signature: (self, note: Note, *, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str])
